modifications.description: Retain upstream 17-entry HTTP/WebDAV ABI and 12 client slots; qualify fixed SDK helpers; require confirmed listening, native stop, successful join and complete mapping/allocation cleanup. Retain resources on uncertain ownership.
Reapply mac2jb serialization-buffer traversal bounds and invalid-address/cycle rejection to the new upstream snapshot.
Add typed BuiltInSystem catalog, read-only system ExeFS/RomFS views and registered original firmware NCA WebDAV export; bound and validate directory listings.
Export the existing read-only Program RomFS and SystemData DataId storage helpers for the WebDAV integration.
Allow a validated backing source path distinct from the public filename, so firmware NCAs can be downloaded in one flat directory.
Type missing/unusable ELicense errors, check RightsId before ES enumeration, and propagate cooperative cancellation through license preparation.
Add a cooperative preparation deadline and progress reporting; always await the native operation before allowing cleanup or retry.
Serve original base/update/DLC NCAs from read-only content filesystems without ELicense preparation or decryption.

Use twelve 256 KiB client read/cache windows to reduce fixed allocation by 48.75 MiB; diagnose allocation size and index size, allow retry only after confirmed cleanup, and never free an invalid nonzero pointer.

Merge MissHexa 40a35ff NSO activation, all program indices/content sections, DLC updates and patched manuals; retain system discovery, standalone DLC, primary download paths, native ELicense contexts and cooperative cancellation.
Retain system/firmware exports and raw fallback; include explicit secondary content and DLC updates in raw exports without FS618 or ES calls; block retry on failed cleanup/restoration.

Port source kinds 0..3 and whole filesystem transaction serialization to the retained Cellenseres HTTP/WebDAV server; rebuild native image from distributed sources. Keep qualified SDK functions, small buffers and proven stop/join cleanup rather than replacing them with the upstream FTP runtime.
Increase the bounded total preparation budget from two to ten minutes for multi-content exports; retain progress notifications and await native settlement before cleanup.
Support Base, Update, DLC and Additional Content export scopes. Resolve original program/manual dependencies without indexing unselected views; preserve file paths and report empty scopes safely.
Namespace HTTP/WebDAV exports under a sanitized title name [TitleID] folder while preserving source paths and category identity.
Omit the internal firmware sentinel from the public firmware folder label.
